movie.title: Feed
movie.overview: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content: This certainly isn't bad, but that doesn't make it good. It is perfectly serviceable and it does what it sets out to do, but there are no bells and whistles here. The characters are unlikable enough so that you don't feel bad when they get murdered. The antagonist is spooky, but the internal rules of the tension is too vague, and that means that it's difficult to build true horror from it. There are some interesting takes here, but it isn't enough to make it into a good movie. I don't think you'll have a bad time, but don't expect to be blown away by this.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Five social media influencers visiting an isolated forest retreat accidentally awaken and must survive an encounter with the world's ancient, original vampire.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A group of five high-profile social media influencers travels to a secluded woodland retreat for a weekend getaway. Their attempt to unplug and create exclusive content goes horribly wrong when they inadvertently disturb a hidden ancient force. Soon, they discover they have awakened the world's very first vampire, turning their weekend into a terrifying fight for survival.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Seeking a break from their digital lives and fresh content for their followers, five social media influencers book a weekend stay at a remote forest retreat. The trip begins as a relaxed escape, but the isolation quickly exposes personal tensions and rivalries within the group. While exploring the surrounding wilderness, they unknowingly disturb an ancient burial site hidden deep within the trees. This careless intrusion releases a dormant, predatory force: the very first vampire to ever walk the earth. As night falls, the creature begins hunting the group one by one, capitalizing on their disorientation and fear. Denied cell service and miles away from help, their digital fame proves entirely useless against a primordial threat. The influencers are forced to navigate the dark, dense woods while trying to find a way to outsmart an immortal predator. Tensions peak as trust erodes, leading to desperate measures for self-preservation. Ultimately, the survivors must face the creature in a brutal showdown to determine if any of them will live to see sunrise.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Feed follows a group of five popular social media influencers who retreat to a remote forest cabin for a weekend of networking, relaxation, and content creation. Blending elements of modern digital culture with classic gothic horror, the story escalates when the group unknowingly unleashes an ancient, primordial vampire hidden in the surrounding woods. As the creature hunts them through the isolated terrain, the film explores themes of clout, vanity, and survival, forcing the influencers to confront an inescapable threat far removed from the digital world.

story_structure.resolution: The tragic aftermath of the night settles over the forest retreat, leaving the surviving characters to face the permanent consequences of their encounter.
story_structure.introduction: Five social media influencers arrive at a secluded forest retreat expecting a quiet weekend to connect with their followers and unwind.
story_structure.risingAction: As strange, threatening occurrences multiply around the cabin, tension mounts within the group as they struggle to understand the nature of the entity hunting them and seek a way to escape.
